I deployed 2 major changes today:

  • ranking algorithm for link and self submissions
  • anti-spamming utility

Whoaverse ranking algorithm has been changed to correct a math error as discovered by /u/721r and the ranking formula now uses exponentiation instead of multiplication. This will add more "weight" to older submissions causing them to "fall off" frontpage faster.

Another big update was done to anti-spamming utility. In an attempt to prevent automated submissions and at the same time, not annoy regular users, "trusted user" status is now calculated based on target subverse where a comment or a submission is being posted.

What this effectively does is allows regular users to post faster/more often than newly registered users, but only to subverses where regular users have enough comment contribution points (if what is being posted is a comment) or link contribution points (if what is being posted is a link or self submission).

For now, threshold to become a "trusted user" is set to 40 CCP for comments and 40 CCP for submissions. Even if a user reaches 40 CCP, he will still not be able to post with "the speed of light" and a delay of 10 seconds is required between posts.

Please test this new throttling mechanism thoroughly and report here if you notice anything unusual or find a security issue.

Thank you all for being patient while I developed this feature.
